items.t: Qualcomm’s CEO Says Chipmakers Are in an “Extreme Shortage”
items.sum: Qualcomm's chief executive says supply is tight, yet his own company claims to have all the chips it needs and investors shrugged. The real story sits in margins, unnamed suppliers, and one number that could expose what the talk really means.

items.t: Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on fueling the AI boom
items.sum: Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon joins Deirdre Bosa and Brian Sozzi at Yahoo Finance's 2026 Invest conference.

items.t: Is Freedom Capital Markets Wrong to Give Up on Qualcomm? Wall Street Still Sees $185
items.sum: Key TakeawaysFreedom Capital Markets downgraded Qualcomm to Hold from Buy on Nov. 9 and cut its price target to $185 from $200, the same as the consensus target.

items.t: Qualcomm's $5 Billion Data Center Ramp Puts Execution in Focus Now
items.sum: QCOM targets $5 billion in fiscal 2027 data center sales, but customer concentration, margin pressure and heavy investments put its execution to the test.

items.t: Is Qualcomm Stock Worth Buying as Diversification Meets Margin Risk?
items.sum: QCOM's automotive and data center growth strengthens diversification, but falling earnings estimates, margin pressure and mixed valuation cloud its buy case.

items.t: SpaceX's New Deal with Qualcomm Aims to Take on Mobile Carriers. History Says It's Going to Be an Uphill Battle.
items.sum: Starlink Mobile will face some hurdles, but it has a few things working in its favor, too.
